en: “Yo, yo! Sorry~”
“It's okay, you can come in whenever you want to.”
“I made some snacks, you want some?”
“Mkay. Finally, I can chill out.”
“I found this when I was sweeping. I figured I should give it to you.”
“My student ID! Thanks!”
“I didn't know you were a college student.”
“Yeah, I'm going to brush up on my studies now that I have some more free time.”
“I've been out of school for half a year. My homework wasn't too good.”
“Plus I have to work, go shopping, go on vacation.”
“Sounds pretty tough.”
“Yeah, but if I don't understand something, Shizuku helps me. I still don't understand a lot though.”
“College, huh...”
“Do you want to go to college?”
“To be honest, if I have the chance, I'd like to try.”
“It's not as fun as it sounds.”
“And I'm not the sharpest tool in the shed. Hey... maybe you could do that problem like this?”
“Hmm?”
“How'd you do that?!”
“Uh... Intuition?”
“Hey, hey. Hang out here for a while!”
I spend some time with Ayano and experience what it's like to do college homework.
